# Get-ZbxHistory

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the history records of the values items collected.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxHistory [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Editable] [-From <DateTimeOffset>] [-Till <DateTimeOffset>] [-ValueType <ZabbixItemValueType>] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxHistory [-SortField <string[]>] -Id <ulong[]> [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Editable] [-From <DateTimeOffset>] [-Till <DateTimeOffset>] [-ValueType <ZabbixItemValueType>] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByFilter

```
Get-ZbxHistory [-SortField <string[]>] -Filter <ZabbixHistoryGetParameters> [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Editable] [-From <DateTimeOffset>] [-Till <DateTimeOffset>] [-ValueType <ZabbixItemValueType>] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A history record is one value an item collected, with its clock; history is kept for each item's history period, then only as hourly trends. The Get-ZbxHistory cmdlet reads them with history.get: all of them up to -Limit, by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole history.get selection in -Filter. -Host narrows the result to the history records of the given hosts, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixHistoryRecord objects or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get an item's history through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests' | Get-ZbxHistory |
    Select-Object Time, Value
```

A piped item binds its ItemId and its ValueType, which names the history table to read, so any item's values come back, numeric or text; Clock is the time of each value.

### Example 2: Get the newest values of a host's numeric items

```powershell
Get-ZbxHistory -Host 'web-01' -SortField clock -SortOrder Descending -Limit 2 | Select-Object ItemId, Clock, Value
```

-Host reads the history of the host's items of one value type (-ValueType, Unsigned when omitted); -SortField/-SortOrder/-Limit keep the newest.

### Example 3: Read text values in a time window

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Status'
$filter = [Community.Zabbix.ZabbixHistoryGetParameters]@{
    History  = 'Text'
    ItemIds  = @($item.ItemId)
    TimeFrom = [int][DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddHours(-1).ToUnixTimeSeconds()
}
Get-ZbxHistory -Filter $filter | Select-Object Clock, Value
```

-Filter takes history.get's own parameters: History picks the value type (Float, Character, Log, Unsigned, Text...), TimeFrom/TimeTill bound the window (Unix time). -ValueType, -From and -Till say the same without -Filter.

## INPUTS

- `ulong[]`: Bound to -Id (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]`: Bound to -HostReference (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixItemValueType`: Bound to -ValueType (ByPropertyName). The item value type values: ITEM_VALUE_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixHistoryRecord`: The history record read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
